**Visual Quality Review — Result: No concrete issues found**

- No text overflow or clipping detected: all labels ("PÊŞBÎRK QEDİYA", "196", "Zîman - %20 rastbûn", stat pills, button text) fit within their containers.
- No overlapping elements; the stars over the dark badge and pills on the purple card are intentional layering, not collisions.
- Contrast is adequate throughout: white text on the purple gradient, dark text on the mint and white cards, and gray secondary text remain readable.
- The low-opacity flag shape in the top-right of the purple card is a decorative watermark, not a legibility problem.
- The partially visible card at the bottom ("Zincîra rojane") is scrollable content and was not counted as an error.

**Conclusion:** The screen appears visually clean with no visible layout, clipping, or contrast defects.
